name: Collect SVG WeatherLink data

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/fetch_svg_weatherlink.py'
      - 'src/audit_integrity.py'
      - 'src/push_private.py'
      - 'src/check_collection_due.py'
      - 'config/integrity_policy.json'
      - 'requirements-runtime.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/collect-svg.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '13 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cloud_canary:
        description: "Bounded B2 transfer test on an isolated control branch"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      watchdog:
        description: 'Routine external watchdog trigger; respects freshness gate'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: public-svg-collector${{ inputs.cloud_canary == true && '-b2-canary' || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  collect:
    if: github.repository == 'janwohlers78/mardorf-data-collector'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check whether routine SVG collection is due
        id: due
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog == true)
        env:
          PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN }}
          PRIVATE_REPO: janwohlers78/mardorf-kitevorhersage
        run: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m mardorf_collector check-collection-due --kind svg --max-age-minutes 40

      - name: Report skipped routine trigger
        if: (github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog == true)) && steps.due.outputs.due != 'true'
        run: |
          {
            echo "## SVG collector schedule check"
            echo
            echo "- Provider fetch skipped: latest successful private transfer is still within the freshness target."
            echo "- Previous success: ${{ steps.due.outputs.last_success_generated_at_utc }}"
            echo "- Age: ${{ steps.due.outputs.age_minutes }} min"
            echo "- Threshold: ${{ steps.due.outputs.threshold_minutes }} min"
            echo "- Reason: ${{ steps.due.outputs.reason }}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependency
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements-runtime.txt
          if [ "${{ inputs.cloud_canary }}" = "true" ] || python -c "import json,sys; sys.exit(0 if json.load(open('config/dev03_cloud_runtime_v1.json'))['production_enabled'] is True else 1)"; then
            python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements-cloud.txt
          fi

      - name: Fetch SVG endpoints and record exact request diagnostics
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          WEATHERLINK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.WEATHERLINK_API_KEY }}
          WEATHERLINK_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.WEATHERLINK_API_SECRET }}
        run: PYTHONPATH=src python -m mardorf_collector.wp13.native_svg_v1 fetch

      - name: Audit endpoint results, observation age and five-minute archive continuity
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true')
        run: |
          PYTHONPATH=src python -m mardorf_collector audit-integrity \
            --kind svg \
            --input work/svg_bundle.json \
            --json-out work/svg_integrity.json \
            --md-out work/svg_integrity.md

      - name: Publish SVG integrity report in Actions summary
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true')
        run: cat work/svg_integrity.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Transfer payload and integrity history to private repository
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true') && (github.event_name != 'push' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[full-svg-validation]'))
        shell: bash
        env:
          PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN }}
          PRIVATE_REPO: janwohlers78/mardorf-kitevorhersage
          B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID }}
          B2_APPLICATION_KEY: ${{ secrets.B2_APPLICATION_KEY }}
          B2_ENDPOINT_URL: ${{ vars.B2_ENDPOINT_URL }}
          B2_REGION: ${{ vars.B2_REGION }}
          B2_BUCKET: ${{ vars.B2_BUCKET }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo 'PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN is not configured; private transfer skipped.'
            exit 0
          fi
          args=(--kind svg --integrity-json work/svg_integrity.json --integrity-md work/svg_integrity.md)
          if [ -f work/svg_bundle.json ]; then
            args+=(--file work/svg_bundle.json)
          fi
          PYTHONPATH=src python -m mardorf_collector.transfer.dispatch publish --cloud-canary "${{ inputs.cloud_canary == true && 'true' || 'false' }}" "${args[@]}"
          if [ "${{ inputs.cloud_canary }}" != "true" ]; then
            PYTHONPATH=src python -m mardorf_collector.wp13.native_svg_v1 publish
          fi

      - name: Fail workflow when granular integrity audit found errors
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true')
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          d=json.load(open('work/svg_integrity.json'))
          print('integrity_status=',d['status'],'errors=',d['error_count'],'warnings=',d['warning_count'])
          if d['error_count']:
              raise SystemExit(1)
          PY

            echo "- Provider fetch skipped: latest successful private transfer is still within the freshness target."
            echo "- Previous success: ${{ steps.due.outputs.last_success_generated_at_utc }}"
            echo "- Age: ${{ steps.due.outputs.age_minutes }} min"
            echo "- Threshold: ${{ steps.due.outputs.threshold_minutes }} min"
            echo "- Reason: ${{ steps.due.outputs.reason }}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true'

          fi

      - name: Fetch SVG endpoints and record exact request diagnostics
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true'
        continue-on-error: true

          WEATHERLINK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.WEATHERLINK_API_KEY }}
          WEATHERLINK_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.WEATHERLINK_API_SECRET }}

      - name: Audit endpoint results, observation age and five-minute archive continuity
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true')

        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true')
        run: cat work/svg_integrity.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Transfer payload and integrity history to private repository
        if: always() && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.watchdog != true) || steps.due.outputs.due == 'true') && (github.event_name != 'push' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[full-svg-validation]'))
        shell: bash
        env:
          PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN }}
